title: provencheria cerastoides
intro: Provencheria cerastoides, commonly known as Mountain Sage, is a small shrub native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Provencheria cerastoides include antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antifungal properties, making it useful for wound healing and skin issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
